views.title: Isometric
criteria: Flat mount pad on solid core; three U-cradles fused by filled convex hulls
No floating sockets or hairline bridges — continuous solid post→U
U openings face downward (drop-in); part not clipped

views.title: Front (−Y)
criteria: Cradle(s) pitched ~35° down; U open downward for leg drop-in
Convex hull blend from post into cradle is a filled taper, not a loft ribbon
M3 hole through cradle walls readable or clearly implied

views.title: Top (+Z)
criteria: Flat circular mount pad; three cradles at 120° (cube-corner top view)
Hulls visible as filled sectors; U-pockets clear of neighbors

views.title: Right (+X)
criteria: Cradle on +X shows stop, pocket depth, and solid hull into the core
Bolt hole ~7.5 mm from stop through section / T-slot center
